7b6bee2ac981bf3153494d6365160faa.description:
PetLabCo.® is the world leader in DTC pet supplements, with nine-figure revenue and ambitious plans for continued global expansion. We make science-backed supplements, health care and treats that millions of dog owners love, powered by a performance marketing engine spending at serious scale across paid social and beyond. Behind that engine we're building a brand that dog owners recognise and trust, which is what turns a strong first purchase into a long relationship. Our team is vibrant, fast moving and customer obsessed. High performers are valued here and they're rewarded, which makes this the ideal place for an ambitious, hardworking animal lover who wants to move their career forward quickly.
About the role:
We’re looking for a Mid-Weight UX/UI Designer to join our growing Design team and help us create digital experiences that don’t just look great – they perform. You’ll work across multiple areas of the PetLab Co. customer journey, from our organic e-commerce site and customer account portal through to cold acquisition funnels and landing pages.
You’ll join a highly collaborative design environment, working closely with two Senior Product Designers, our Lead Digital Designer, two Mid-Weight Creative Designers and our Design & UX Director. Rather than being restricted to one product or area, you’ll support the team wherever the biggest design opportunities and commercial priorities are.
A key measure of success will be conversion . We’re looking for someone who understands that great DTC design needs to balance customer needs, brand, usability and commercial performance. You should have a keen eye for what converts, be curious about why customers behave the way they do, and be comfortable using data and experimentation to improve your work.
No two weeks will necessarily look the same. One week you might be improving the UX of our organic e-commerce experience, the next designing a cold acquisition funnel, and the next helping evolve our account portal or supporting a high-priority commercial initiative.
Love designing polished, intuitive digital experiences that drive measurable results
Understand the nuances of designing for DTC and e-commerce customers
Think about conversion and customer behaviour , not just aesthetics
Enjoy moving between different products, journeys and commercial challenges
Can take a problem from initial thinking and wireframes through to high-quality UI
Enjoy collaborating with other designers while being comfortable owning your own work
Have a positive, can-do attitude and aren’t afraid to roll your sleeves up when something needs to get done
Thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities and challenges can change
…then please keep reading, as you may be the perfect fit.
You’ll sit within our Design team and work closely with our Design & UX Director , alongside our Lead Digital Designer, Senior Product Designers and Creative Designers. We’re building a design function that can support PetLab Co. across the entire digital customer experience. As the business continues to grow, so does the number and variety of customer journeys we need to create, optimise and improve.
We need another strong pair of hands who can move comfortably between different areas of the customer experience and help the wider team tackle the opportunities with the greatest potential impact.
You’ll have experienced designers around you to collaborate with, challenge ideas and learn from, but you’ll also be expected to take ownership. We want someone who can receive a brief or problem, understand the customer and commercial objective behind it, explore solutions and turn those into thoughtful, high-quality experiences.
We care deeply about craft, but we’re equally interested in what the work achieves . You’ll work with your manager and the wider team to understand performance, learn from experiments and continuously improve our digital experiences.
Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who wants to become a better design

782f6fee1e2011cb71d2de479e471fde.title: Product Designer, Design Systems
782f6fee1e2011cb71d2de479e471fde.description:
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Design at Anthropic sits at the intersection of craft, research, and product intuition. Design systems is a growing team working on products that millions of people use daily, and on interactions that don't have established conventions yet.
Our work shapes how people experience AI: whether Claude feels like a tool or a collaborator, whether it earns trust or erodes it. We partner closely with engineers and researchers, often designing around capabilities that are emerging in real time. That means staying close to the models, prototyping rapidly, and being comfortable with ambiguity.
We care deeply about the details that make something feel polished, trustworthy and human. We ship fast and learn in the open. We'd rather get something in front of users and iterate than wait for perfection.
The Design Systems team exists to define and elevate the language of our UI and core interactions. Every Claude product, from claude.ai to Claude Code, shares one system, including the guidance Claude itself follows when it generates UI.
You would be joining an early-stage team, working with design engineers and product designers across the company.
Are as comfortable designing on canvas tools as you are building and prototyping within the product, and prefer to ship in days, not months.
Have worked on design systems that balance simplicity with creative flair to produce beautiful products out of the box.
Care about the smallest details as much as the big picture, from a pixel to how the whole app fits together.
Make the people around you better through sharp, kind feedback and low ego.
Get up to speed quickly and can make an impact on projects already in motion.
Design and evolve the system, from foundations (colour, type, spacing, icons, tokens, theming) to components like menus, dialogs, sidebars and the chat composer.
Design the expressive layer as a system, not one-offs: motion, illustration and icons that are brand and system at once.
Make the system legible to Claude as well as people: the guidance, metadata and evals that show whether Claude uses it correctly.
Partner with product teams: help designers and engineers apply the system well, and feed recurring gaps back into the system.
Prototype in code and ship: land changes in the design-system package alongside engineers, using Claude Code in your own practice.
Minimum qualifications
Experience building or working on a design system.
Experience with design tokens, theming and accessibility standards.
Fluency in whichever tool gets an idea across fastest, from Figma to code.
Preferred qualifications
Experience building products at the highest level of craft.
Has shipped voice or other beyond-the-screen work, with native mobile instincts.
Has designed an icon set, illustration style or motion system used across products.
Experience defining evals, lint rules or automated checks for UI quality.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Retell is building infrastructure and tools that power real-time AI voice agents used by fast-growing companies. We care deeply about making complex, technical workflows feel clear, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed.
As a Product Designer Intern at Retell, you’ll work closely with our designer, engineers, and founders to bring product ideas to life. You’ll take ownership of scoped design projects, moving from early explorations and prototypes to polished experiences that reach real customers.
This is a hands-on opportunity to develop your product thinking, strengthen your visual craft, and learn how great design gets shipped, with guidance and feedback from the team.
Design user flows and interfaces for building, testing, and managing AI voice agents, making complex interactions easier to understand and navigate.
Take scoped projects from initial concepts and wireframes to polished designs, incorporating feedback along the way.
Create interactive prototypes in Figma to communicate ideas, explore alternatives, and refine interactions.
Work side-by-side with engineers to ship features, clarify edge cases, and ensure the finished experience reflects the design.
Identify UX friction and visual inconsistencies, and propose thoughtful, practical improvements.
Contribute reusable components, patterns, and documentation to Retell’s design system.
Hold a high bar for craft, paying attention to typography, spacing, hierarchy, interaction states, and consistency.
You’re a current student or recent graduate in design, HCI, or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.
You have a portfolio that demonstrates product thinking, visual craft, and clear design decisions. Class projects, personal projects, and previous internship work all count.
You’re comfortable using Figma to create interfaces, reusable components, and interactive prototypes.
You have a strong sense of usability, hierarchy, and visual clarity.
You’re detail-oriented and care deeply about polish and consistency.
You can explain your decisions, welcome feedback, and iterate thoughtfully.
You take initiative, ask good questions, and feel comfortable working through ambiguity.
You’re excited about AI and enjoy collaborating closely with designers, engineers, and founders.
Work directly with the founders and product team.
Get a front-row seat to how one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure startups builds products.
Own meaningful projects from day one, not busy work.
Learn how world-class AI products are launched, documented, and continuously improved.
See your work impact thousands of developers and enterprise customers.
If you love building systems, making products easier to use, and want to accelerate your career in product, we’d love to meet you.
